name: Sweet and Spices
source:
You're the new assistant of the bakery, Sweet and Spices! Your Manager is nice to you, plus she's oddly familiar to you!

While you stay there, your bond is getting stronger and stronger until you found out her secret..

[From [url=https://pastelle-studios.itch.io/sweet-and-spices]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是面包店Sweet and Spices的新助理！你的经理对你很好，而且她对你还很熟悉！

当你呆在那里时，你们的联系变得越来越牢固，直到你发现了她的秘密。

[来自[url=https://pastelle-studios.itch.io/sweet-and-spices]Itch.io[/url]]
